document: Cross-Canada Outlook: Provincial Issues, Politics, and Government Performance: British Columbia (Angus Reid Institute, 2025-09-11)
note: Online, Angus Reid Forum, national n=4,330 (BC subsample). Shares among leaning and decided voters from the release PDF chart 'Vote intention: B.C.' (2025.09.11_Canada_Outlook_BC.pdf, p. 6); n = bases printed on the chart. The 'Other party' segment for Island/ North Coast is not labelled (residual about 1 point), so AUTRES is omitted there. Region labels verbatim; 'Fraser Valley' is ARI's Lower Mainland outside Metro Vancouver; 'Island/ North Coast' coded VANCOUVER-ISLAND-NORTH-COAST.
